title: Weighted Composition-differentiation operators on weighted Dirichlet spaces
summary: We study weighted composition-differentiation operators of order $n,$ $D^n_{ψ,\varphi}f:= ψ\cdot f^{(n)}\circ \varphi$ on weighted Dirichlet spaces. Our main goal is to describe the operator-theoretic properties of $D^n_{ψ,\varphi}$ in terms of the inducing functions $ψ$ and $\varphi.$ We characterize bounded, compact, and Hilbert-Schmidt class of such operators and estimate their essential norms.
